items.html: Understand also that the externality of the upper one that descends is not from the whole of it, but only the Malchut within the externality of the Malchut within it. For indeed, when we say that the externality of NHY descends, we mean the Malchut within that externality, which stands in the NHY of the externality — since that entire externality is only the ten Sefirot of the Malchut of that Partzuf.
